newsitem.title: CHINA: China Gintian first-half net 14 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Gintian first-half net 14 mln yuan.

text.p: China's Gintian Industry (Group) Co Ltd posted net profits of 13.85 million yuan ($1.66 million), or 0.041 yuan per share, for the first half of this year, the Shenzhen stock exchange said on Thursday.
The exchange, in an announcement after the close of trading, did not give comparative figures or specify whether the results were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
Gintian, a Shenzhen-based conglomerate engaged in real estate development, textiles and foreign trade, is the first of the 49 Shenzhen-listed B share companies to release its 1997 interim results.
Gintian posted net profits of 29.84 million yuan, or 0.107 yuan per share, for the first half of 1996 under Chinese accounting rules. It did not give figures based on international standards.
Trading in Gintian's A shares for domestic investors and B shares for foreigners would be suspended on Friday morning and would resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
